panels.title: Latest daily rate
panels.description: Selic rate (SGS 11, % per business day) of the latest observation in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS daily_rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest annualized rate
panels.description: Latest daily rate in range compounded over 252 business days (% per year).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(annualized_rate, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS annualized_rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Change vs 30 days ago
panels.description: Latest annualized rate in range minus the annualized rate on or before 30 calendar days earlier, in percentage points. Empty when there is no observation that far back.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, annualized_rate
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
l AS (
  SELECT max(ref_dt) AS ref_dt
  FROM d
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT (
  arg_max(annualized_rate, d.ref_dt) FILTER (WHERE d.ref_dt <= l.ref_dt)
  - arg_max(annualized_rate, d.ref_dt) FILTER (WHERE d.ref_dt <= l.ref_dt - 30)
)::DOUBLE AS change_pp
FROM d, l

panels.title: Change vs 365 days ago
panels.description: Latest annualized rate in range minus the annualized rate on or before 365 calendar days earlier, in percentage points. Empty when there is no observation that far back.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, annualized_rate
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
l AS (
  SELECT max(ref_dt) AS ref_dt
  FROM d
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT (
  arg_max(annualized_rate, d.ref_dt) FILTER (WHERE d.ref_dt <= l.ref_dt)
  - arg_max(annualized_rate, d.ref_dt) FILTER (WHERE d.ref_dt <= l.ref_dt - 365)
)::DOUBLE AS change_pp
FROM d, l

panels.title: Accumulated in range
panels.description: Selic compounded over every business day in range: product of (1 + daily rate) minus 1.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (product(1 + value::DOUBLE / 100) - 1) * 100 AS accumulated_rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Observations
panels.description: Business days with a published Selic rate in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS observations
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Daily rate
panels.description: Selic rate per business day (% a.d.), as published in SGS 11.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  value::DOUBLE AS "Daily rate"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Annualized rate
panels.description: Daily rate compounded over 252 business days (% a.a.); steps mark Copom decisions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  annualized_rate::DOUBLE AS "Annualized rate"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Accumulated since start of range
panels.description: Running product of (1 + daily rate) minus 1 from the first business day in range: the return of a Selic-indexed investment started then.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  (product(1 + value::DOUBLE / 100) OVER (ORDER BY ref_dt) - 1) * 100 AS "Accumulated Selic"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Accumulated per month
panels.description: Selic compounded over the business days of each month (% a.m.); partial months at the edges of the range only include the days in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('month', ref_dt)::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  (product(1 + value::DOUBLE / 100) - 1) * 100 AS "Accumulated in month"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Rate changes
panels.description: Business days in range where the daily rate differs from the previous observation, with the old and new annualized rates.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    value,
    annualized_rate,
    lag(value) OVER w AS prev_value,
    lag(annualized_rate) OVER w AS prev_annualized_rate
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ref_dt)
)
SELECT
  ref_dt AS effective_from,
  prev_value::DOUBLE AS old_daily_rate,
  value::DOUBLE AS new_daily_rate,
  prev_annualized_rate::DOUBLE AS old_annualized_rate,
  annualized_rate::DOUBLE AS new_annualized_rate,
  (annualized_rate - prev_annualized_rate)::DOUBLE AS change_pp
FROM d
WHERE prev_value IS NOT NULL
  AND value <> prev_value
  AND $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY ref_dt DESC

panels.title: Monthly summary
panels.description: Business days, average daily and annualized rates, annualized range and compounded Selic per month in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  strftime(date_trunc('month', ref_dt), '%Y-%m') AS month,
  count(*) AS business_days,
  avg(value)::DOUBLE AS avg_daily_rate,
  avg(annualized_rate)::DOUBLE AS avg_annualized_rate,
  min(annualized_rate)::DOUBLE AS min_annualized_rate,
  max(annualized_rate)::DOUBLE AS max_annualized_rate,
  (product(1 + value::DOUBLE / 100) - 1) * 100 AS accumulated_rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month DESC
